I also wanted an instrument for the category rule (C3) and a plan-level check of the reads (C5). Scope of a call and trace of a call can only be asked for on named lines during the work, from the allowance. A trace on each sending call would be needed for C10. The price also leaves no room for a second undo rehearsal at A3 or for same set and summary of the change at A2.
